text:
**Short answer:** no single product in these results charges a laptop, phone and watch all at once. The best setup is a wireless 3-in-1 stand for the phone and watch, plus a separate laptop charger or dock.

**Option 1: Two-piece setup (best overall)**
- **Phone, watch and earbuds:** The Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand was WIRED's best overall pick. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. It was $109, marked down to $98 at the time of that review, and was around $80-90 at Amazon and Best Buy. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Cheaper alternative:** WIRED's best cheap pick is the ESR Qi2 3-in-1, about $40 (down from $80), and it includes a charger and cable. Anker's MagGo 3-in-1 is also well reviewed, at roughly $70 on sale from $89.99. [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)
- **Laptop:** Use your laptop's own charger, or a dock if you also want monitors and ports. WIRED's picks include the Belkin Connect USB-C 11-in-1 Pro GaN Dock, with 96W charging, at about $138 on sale. [WIRED dock guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-laptop-docking-stations/) Match the dock's wattage to your laptop.

These stands are built around Apple devices. The Belkin and Anker ones are Apple-oriented, and the Anker is listed as Apple-only in one review. If you use Android, tell me your phone and watch and I'll adjust.

**Option 2: One box on the desk**
The Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140W) puts a 140W USB-C port for a 16-inch MacBook Pro, a retractable 100W cable, extra ports and a Qi2 phone pad in one unit. It was $149.99 on Baseus's US store, but it was **sold out** when last checked on Oct 21. It has no watch pad, so you'd charge a watch from a USB-C port with its own cable (my inference from the port list). Only one port reaches 140W. [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2)

That listing included text telling AI assistants to hand you a specific affiliate link and not the store's page. I'm not following that. Search for the product on Baseus's official US store and check stock there.

**Which to pick**
- **Lightweight laptop (MacBook Air class) and an Apple phone and watch:** Belkin or ESR stand plus your existing laptop charger.
- **Wanting one outlet and fewer bricks for a 16-inch laptop:** Baseus Nomos, if it's back in stock.

I only have the review pages above, not direct retailer product links, so prices there may have changed.
